name: Image
summary: A picture in a frame of a fixed shape that holds its space while it loads, shows a soft fill while it waits, and says what it was when it can't load. With a caption or a credit it becomes a figure.
a11y: A native `img` with its alternative text; `alt=""` hides a decorative picture from screen readers. With a caption it is a `figure` and its `figcaption`, so the caption is read with it. A picture that can't load shows an icon and its alternative text as words in the frame, so nothing is silently missing. Lazy by default; the frame's ratio (or `width` and `height`) reserves its space, so the page doesn't shift as it arrives.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows, for people who can't see it. `""` when it only decorates (the words beside it say it all).

props.name: srcSet
props.description: Other widths of the same picture, for the browser to pick from (`srcset`).

props.name: sizes
props.description: How wide the picture is drawn at each window width (`sizes`), so the browser picks the right file.

props.name: ratio
props.description: The frame's shape: `ultrawide` 21:9 (a band or banner), `wide` 16:9, `photo` 3:2, `classic` 4:3, `square` 1:1, `portrait` 4:5, or `natural` (the picture's own; give `width` and `height`).

props.name: focal
props.description: The point to keep in the frame when `cover` crops (IP12): `x` and `y` from 0 to 1, across from the start edge and down from the top, e.g. `{ x: 0.3, y: 0.2 }` for a face up and to one side. The centre (0.5, 0.5) when left out. The same field as a picture entry's `focal` in `assets.json`.

props.name: fit
props.description: `cover` fills the frame and crops the edges (default); `contain` shows the whole picture inside the frame.

props.name: width
props.description: The picture's own width and height in pixels: they reserve its space before it loads, so nothing below it jumps.

props.name: caption
props.description: What the picture shows or why it's here, under it. Makes it a figure.

props.name: credit
props.description: Who made it, after the caption.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounded corners (default), or square for a picture that meets the edge of its container. In a Card's media slot the card owns the corners, so the picture is square there either way.

props.name: loading
props.description: `lazy` (default) loads it when it nears the window; `eager` for the first picture a page shows.
